messages:
maria: Heads-up — DeepBank (dedicated pool: db-pool-prod) reporting p99 spikes on embeddings since ~00:30 UTC. Ticket DB-523. Need owners, short-term mitigation, and ETA for proper fix.
kevin: I'm taking point for platform changes. Can you paste a sample request_id and any logs? Also confirm if they're hitting a specific model or route.
maria: sample req: req_8a3f9b2e; customer says most failures on /v1/embeddings and latency > 2s. Logs: 

```
2026-03-16T00:31:02Z worker-7 OOM while allocating KV cache
2026-03-16T00:31:03Z route embeddings.r2 model r2-13b-quant -> retry
2026-03-16T00:31:04Z p99 2.83s p50 0.12s
```

kevin: looks like worker-7 hitting memory pressure causing retries. @ashok do you think model quant/profile could be part of it?
ashok: yep — model r2-13b-quant has higher memory footprint with current KV cache config. Two options: reduce kv cache retention for this route or route to r2-6b-quant fallback. Routing change is quick (~30m) + CR. Longer term we should adjust kernel selection for longer sequences.
julia: I’ve scaled db-pool-prod up by 2 nodes as an emergency mitigation (manual add). Autoscaler was at capacity. Monitoring dashboards now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: Customer asked for ETA on a stable workaround we can commit to. If we can guarantee a fallback route within 1h, they’ll accept that temporarily.
kevin: Plan proposal: 1) immediate: temporary routing rule — if embedding request latency > 1.2s or worker retry count > 1, route to r2-6b-quant (fallback). 2) mid: reduce kv cache retention to 25% for embeddings route. 3) long: kernel memory optimization + postmortem. I can implement (1) in ~30m and (2) in ~2-3h with a config CR. Need reviewers for both.
ashok: I'll open the CR for cache retention and the model-bump PR now. Pushing branch: feature/db-deepbank-fallback commit 5a8d3f.
kevin: pinging reviewers: @nate, @julia — can you do a quick CR on the routing policy change? It’s mostly config.
nate: will review in ~20m, can approve if tests pass. :eyes:
julia: reviewing the scale we did — p99 has already dropped to ~0.9s after adding nodes, looks promising. Still want the routing fallback until we confirm stability.
sre-bot: autoscaler: manual_scale event applied to cluster db-pool-prod, +2 GPUs.
maria: customer update: DeepBank OK with fallback if deployed within 1h. They want a brief note for their SREs about expected behavior and how to opt back to main route.
kevin: creating quick runbook snippet to paste to customer + will tag it in the ticket. Example routing rule (will be in CR):

```
match: route == "embeddings" and (latency_p99 > 1.2s or retry_count > 1)
action: route_to: "r2-6b-quant-fallback"
ttl: 60m
```

ashok: PRs pushed: 1) routing-policy change (PR #812) 2) cache-retention tweak (PR #813). Leaving short description in each.
kevin: quick CR notes: 813 changes metrics threshold for kv cache retention -> affects TTLs, tested locally with sim. 812 is safe rollbackable. @nate please prioritize 812.
nate: reviewing 812 now. If green I'll merge and trigger canary to 10% of pool.
julia: I'll watch canary and check p99, errors, and memory pressure graphs.
maria: next steps I captured: - kevin: deploy routing CR canary -> 10% within 30m - nate: review+merge 812 -> canary - julia: monitor canary + escalate if error rate increases - ashok: follow-up cache PR and performance bench - maria: update customer and document fallback runbook.
kevin: tagging timeframe: routing can be live ~00:55 UTC, full rollout after 15m of canary if stable.
sam: thanks team — I’ll update DeepBank and set expectation for a post-incident note by EOD.
maria: thanks everyone. If anything regresses, @kevin escalate to oncall immediately and include the request_id. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted, will keep ticket DB-523 updated with timestamps and notes.
